Sofia (Product): quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A 11 folks want crisp launch windows for: API billing tiers, Console batching controls, and Optimize recommendation engine. can we publish a minimal timeline and owners today?

Noah (Eng): sure. high level: API tiers - beta late July; Console batching - internal canary end of June; Optimize (read-only suggestions) - end of June, write-mode later. details follow.

Ivy (DevEx): real ask from teams is the migration impact. will existing keys continue to behave the same? we need a short FAQ and an example opt-out API.

Noah (Eng): default: no change for existing keys. opt-in model for tiered billing. opt-out endpoint we plan to expose for batching controls: ``PUT /v1/tenant/features {"smart_batching":false}``. permissioned to admin roles.

Sofia (Product): can we get specific dates (not vague "end of month") so marketing and sales can plan? even approximate week ranges help.

Marcus (Marketing): marketing needs a one-liner + timeline to publish on the customer portal. prefer the phrasing: "internal canary late-June; partner beta early-July; public GA late-July" if engineering can commit.

Noah (Eng): committing where we can: Console batching internal canary: 2024-06-26; partner beta: 2024-07-08; public rollout: 2024-07-22 (pending certify). API tiers beta: 2024-07-29, GA mid-August. Optimize read-only suggestions: 2024-06-30. write-mode TBD early September.

Hannah (Sales): Sales request: a migration playbook + a short script AEs can use on discovery calls. also need explicit rollback steps for customers who see regressions.

Ivy (DevEx): I'll draft the playbook and a sample AE script. will include the rollback snippet and per-route override examples. target: July 3 draft.

Tariq (Legal): legal note: for API billing tiers we need contract addenda and pricing guardrails. if product sends proposed terms by July 1, legal will return language by July 10. also need to confirm data usage language for Optimize suggestions.

Sofia (Product): product action items: (1) publish timeline doc with per-feature footnotes (owner: Sofia) by EOD, (2) migration playbook (owner: Ivy) by July 3, (3) draft customer FAQ (owner: Marcus + Hannah) by July 5, (4) legal terms proposal (owner: Sofia) to Tariq by July 1.

Noah (Eng): engineering tasks: add per-tenant opt-out, shipping telemetry for batching efficacy (batching ratio, p50/p95 token latency), and a read-only flag for Optimize. will open PRs by 2024-06-21 for canary.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: runtime v1.9.2 -> us-west on 2024-06-26T03:00:00Z (4 nodes).

Sofia (Product): thanks all. i'll post the single-page timeline in #all-hands and #customer-comm now and pin it. will tag owners on the doc. reconvene in #product-next-week to confirm final comms. :spiral_calendar_pad:
